articles.title: Ethereum developers propose first step to protect ETH staking from quantum attacks
articles.snippet: A draft proposal would allow validators to deposit with quantum-resistant keys, then permanently stop accepting the format the network runs on today.

articles.title: XRP’s 44% rally brings leverage back, raising risk of sharper pullback
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant data show XRP’s estimated leverage ratio on Binance at its highest since January, with long accounts outnumbering shorts as futures volume runs more than five times spot trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin enters ‘initial phase’ of new bull market, but $83K remains key: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant says Bitcoin’s 24% rally has flipped key market indicators bullish, though rising profit-taking could bring near-term turbulence.

articles.title: Ethereum Devs Propose Deposit Contract Overhaul to Quantum-Proof Staking
articles.snippet: The proposal would let validator keys grow to 8,192 bytes and adds a switch that permanently retires today's BLS signatures.
